full_judgment: 27. Applications of the petitioners to the SDO and the Government dated 26-3-72, 4-11-75, 18-9-76, 7-12-77, 11-10-86 together with documents and papers viz, Mutation Case No. 1020/88, Certified copy of CS Khatian issued on 27-7-86, certified copy of SA Khatian issued on 27-7-86, Certified copy of ex parte decree and order sheet of TS No. 160/72, Certified copy of Title Execution Case No. 9/75, Mutation of Khatian in the name of the petitioners dated 24-6-76, Rent Receipts for payment of rent, Certified copy of RS Khatian, mutation of the name of the petitioners in the records of Dhaka Municipal Corporation on 7-3-78, Receipts for payment of Municipal taxes, Certified copies of the dismissal order of the application and the order sheet of the Misc. Case filed for setting aside the ex parte decree and the agreement of Akhtari Begum with Mesbahuddin Ahmed dated 29-4-70 clearly show that the petitioners are the citizens of Bangladesh and they all have been residing in Bangladesh althrough and they never left for Pakistan.
